description:
## Goal

Make fact demand, blocked-wait expansion, settled arbitration and dependency subscription replacement edge-triggered at the existing DependencyIndex authority.

## Model

A newly unsatisfied FactUse records one exact producer/arbitration edge. Demand-enabled boundaries consume that edge once. Reads, waits and outputs remain owned by DependencyIndex; World::demand_fact_producer remains the typed fact-to-producer map. ProductMemo remains the only product-state authority.

Replacement of read/wait sets diffs previous and next memberships: unchanged edges remain in place and preserve continuous deterministic order; only withdrawals and introductions mutate indexes. Add no second subscriber index unless final-model genuine removals prove one is necessary.

External-product finality uses exact recorded observations. Do not add a World frontier, stall inventory, upstream search, second graph, private queue, root scan, or generalized copy of ProductMemo rooted membership.

## Prerequisites

fz-tfn.21 removes dormant derivation identity. fz-tfn.57 supplies complete failed-attempt observations so deleting unresolved scans cannot strand failed producers.

## TDD

Pin exact first demand, co-produced facts, AND waits, blocked/failure repair, cancellation, quiet cuts, external product ground, shared fan-out, unchanged membership replacement, relevant withdrawal, pre-settlement SeedRoot controls, and FIFO/LIFO/permuted execution. Every producer start has one recorded cause.

## Required deletion and acceptance

Delete unresolved-wait discovery and producer-poke scans, drain-time expansion, upstream external-ground search, unchanged subscription remove/reinsert churn, obsolete ordering paths, transition counters and parked comparison code. No readiness-only or unexplained evaluation remains. Unchanged and unrelated requests do zero requested-root work; relevant changes reach exact readers. The old parked candidate is evidence only and is never restored wholesale.

This ticket absorbs fz-kdt.7.

comments.text: Cold review exposed a general binder-scoped semantic-order prerequisite now owned by fz-tfn.26. Partition the existing uncommitted diff: .26 gets structural addressing/TyCanon/all observable ordering and its proofs; .46 retains only exact wait edges, settlement/arbitration, causal session accounting, and dependent docs/tests. Rebase .46 on the reviewed .26 commit; no mechanism is deferred or dropped.

Current-base integration RED after fz-tfn.5: exact-edge candidate stalls deterministically on Settled(ActivationAnalyzed(FunctionId(205))) because it assumes the deleted separate root frontier. With the sole activation frontier, a blocked first AnalyzeActivation run is retired and no later exact edge re-ignites it. Any diagnostic restoration of the old scanner is probe-only and forbidden from delivery. Correct the missing publication/wait edge after fz-tfn.26; preserve the one-frontier model.

title: Make fact demand and subscriptions exact-edge-triggered
